title: The Palace Hardens Around Values
hero_prompt: A Haeckel-style naturalist engraving of a palace wall caught mid-crystallization — fine geometric crystal facets growing outward from a single seed-point and interlocking into solid stone, rendered in precise fine-line engraving with delicate stippled shading. The crystal lattice thickens toward one edge, weight becoming architecture. Hand-made Haeckel-style naturalist crystal engraving, with visible ink, brush or print texture on paper; flat and graphic, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field, no glossy highlights.
